title: Level
body:
Syntax: level

Description: Displays your ninja level, total experience, next-level cumulative XP threshold, and additional XP needed. At a rank cap, no more XP can advance the character until they earn the next normal rank.

Rank caps: Student 10, Genin 35, Chunin 100, Special Jonin 200, Jonin 250, Kage 250. Jounin is the highest normal rank and becomes obtainable at level 200. Kage is only appointed using SETKAGE.

Mastered jutsu can earn additional damage breakthroughs at levels 100, 125, 150, 175, 200, 225, and 250.

Date: 2026-11-12
